issues.message: A newer version of androidx.test:runner than 1.5.0 is available: 1.5.2

The attribute `android:allowBackup` is deprecated from Android 12 and higher and may be removed in future versions. Consider adding the attribute `android:dataExtractionRules` specifying an `@xml` resource which configures cloud backups and device transfers on Android 12 and higher.
Very long vector path (833 characters), which is bad for performance. Considering reducing precision, removing minor details or rasterizing vector.

fix: API27-only windowLightNavigationBar moved to values-v27 and values-v31; minSdk26 unchanged; no lint baseline or suppression added
